text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek has gotten her racing<n>groove back and
smiles, knowing that<n>she's able to race vigorously
once<n>more.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While she is unable to win the Kikuka<n>Sho, she has
learned a lot through the<n>Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She leaves the Classics behind and<n>we decide to
tackle the Nakayama<n>racecourse winter race—the
Arima<n>Kinen!
